name: Control-Tower
description: End-to-end Executive Supply Chain & Sales Analytics Platform with multi-dimensional filtering, relational SQLite engine, Random Forest delay prediction ML pipeline, and interactive Plotly dashboards.

paragraphs: An enterprise-grade, production-ready interactive analytics platform and predictive control tower designed for Chief Supply Chain Officers (CSCO), Chief Commercial Officers (CCO), and Operations Directors. Features an end-to-end data pipeline, relational SQLite modeling with analytical views, a trained scikit-learn Random Forest delay risk engine, and an executive Streamlit UI.
